lines.en: Fatima, why didn't you come to my party on Saturday? I waited for you until midnight, and honestly I was a little annoyed.
lines.pt: Fatima, por que você não veio à minha festa no sábado? Esperei por você até a meia-noite e, sinceramente, fiquei um pouco irritado.

lines.en: I didn't know it had moved to eight! If you'd told me, I would have been there on time.
lines.pt: Eu não sabia que tinha mudado para as oito! Se você tivesse me dito, eu teria chegado a tempo.

lines.en: But I sent a message to the whole group. If you had checked your phone, you would have seen it.
lines.pt: Mas mandei mensagem para o grupo todo. Se você tivesse olhado seu celular, teria visto a mensagem.

lines.en: My phone had died that afternoon, and I couldn't find my charger anywhere. By the time I noticed, it was already nine.
lines.pt: Meu celular tinha morrido naquela tarde, e não achei o carregador em lugar nenhum. Quando percebi, já eram nove.

lines.en: That's a good reason, I guess. Still, I felt ignored, because you usually answer within minutes, and everybody asked where you were.
lines.pt: É uma boa razão, eu acho. Mesmo assim, me senti ignorado, porque você costuma responder em minutos, e todo mundo perguntou onde você estava.

lines.en: I'm really sorry. If I had known, I would have called you at once. What did you tell them?
lines.pt: Sinto muito mesmo. Se eu soubesse, teria ligado na hora. O que você disse a eles?

lines.en: I said you were probably stuck at work. Then Sam's brother started a karaoke contest, and honestly, I forgot about the whole thing.
lines.pt: Disse que você provavelmente estava presa no trabalho. Aí o irmão do Sam começou um concurso de karaokê e, sinceramente, esqueci toda a história.

lines.en: Karaoke? I'd have loved that! I can sing one song terribly in front of people. Please tell me someone filmed it.
lines.pt: Karaokê? Eu teria adorado! Sei cantar uma música horrivelmente na frente de todo mundo. Por favor, diga que alguém filmou isso.

lines.en: Of course they did. The video is hilarious, and I'll send it to you once you promise not to ignore my next invitation.
lines.pt: Claro que filmaram. O vídeo é hilário, e eu mando para você assim que prometer não ignorar meu próximo convite.

lines.en: I promise. Actually, this misunderstanding was a lesson: let's make a rule that important changes get a phone call, not just a message.
lines.pt: Prometo. Na verdade, esse mal-entendido foi uma lição: vamos criar uma regra de que mudanças importantes recebam uma ligação, não só uma mensagem.

lines.en: Good rule. And I'll throw another party next month, so you can redeem yourself. Bring your charger, and a better excuse!
lines.pt: Boa regra. E vou dar outra festa no mês que vem, para você se redimir. Traga seu carregador e uma desculpa melhor!

facts.big: if + had + part., would have + part.
facts.label: 3º condicional
facts.sub: Passado irreal: If you’d told me, I’d have understood. Nunca would have no if. Com hadn’t para o negativo.

facts.label: Se tivesse
facts.sub: Use if + had + particípio para imaginar um passado que não aconteceu: If you’d told me. Na fala vira you’d told me. Atenção: ’d aqui é had.

facts.label: Teria feito
facts.sub: O resultado do 3º condicional: I would have understood. Na fala vira I’d have understood. Fala do que teria acontecido, mas não aconteceu.

We say “If I would have known, I would have come”. → Falso (We say If I had known, I would have come.)

pages.title: The party that Bia missed · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a drizzly Monday in Portland. Ada and Bia meet in a small café. Ada had a birthday party on Saturday. Bia never arrived. Each friend has a different story. They try to understand what went wrong.

“Why didn’t you come to my party on Saturday, Bia? I waited for you until midnight.” says Ada. “I didn’t know it had moved to eight! If you’d told me, I would have been there on time.” says Bia. “But I sent a message to the whole group. If you had checked your phone, you would have seen it.” says Ada.

pages.title: The party that Bia missed · 2/3
paragraphs: “My phone had died. If I had charged it, I would have noticed the change, but I forgot.” says Bia. “Well, if you hadn’t forgotten, we would have celebrated together. So what did you do then?” says Ada. “I went to the old address and waited outside. If I had known the truth, I wouldn’t have spent two hours in the rain.” says Bia.

“Oh no. If I had known, I would have called you at once. I thought you wanted to ignore me.” says Ada. “Honestly, if I had been in your place, I would have thought the same. It was a classic misunderstanding.” says Bia. “If we had talked sooner, we wouldn’t have felt so annoyed. Next time, I’ll phone people who don’t answer.” says Ada.

paragraphs: “And I’ll tell you if my battery is low. If I had done that, none of this would have happened.” says Bia. “Exactly. If you’d come, you’d have met my cousin, who flew in from Seattle.
